output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the owner calls mintToken, the amount of tokens to be minted is added to the target's balance without a check, allowing the balance of the contract to become extremely large, and in turn, the owner's balance to become extremely large, causing a devaluation of the token.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it gets stuck in overflowed state, causing buy function to be frozen.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the balanceOf[_to] += _value overflows, it gets stuck in overflowed state, causing buy function to be frozen.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount is calculated, it can overflow and cause buy function to be frozen.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When the amount * sellPrice is calculated, it can overflow and cause sell function to be frozen.
